t032: If you want to finally write beats with chords that actually move people...
t033: The kind of progressions that sound like records, not random notes...
t034: Then this is going to be the most important page you read all year.
t036: We are The Grind Studio.
t037: A collective of platinum-certified producers and beatmakers based across Europe.
t038: Between us, we've placed records on charting albums.
t040: And spent the last decade in studios learning what actually separates a beat that gets skipped from a beat that gets repeated.
t041: And one of the biggest answers, after all those years?
t043: The drums make you nod. But the harmony is what makes a song stick — what gives you the goosebumps, the hook, the feeling you can't name but can't stop replaying.
t044: So one day we asked ourselves a question:
t045: What if instead of guessing at chords from scratch every single time...
t046: We could just steal the skeleton from records that already proved they work?
t049: We sat down and transcribed the chord progressions of 1,000 of the biggest songs in modern music.
t050: By hand. By ear. Note for note.
t051: Every chord. Every voicing. Every inversion. Every passing change and borrowed note that makes a progression feel expensive instead of obvious.
t052: Then we exported every single one as a MIDI file — labelled with the original key and BPM.
t053: And here's where it gets interesting.
t054: Because MIDI is just data.
t055: It's not audio. It's not a sample. It's not a loop.
t057: Which means zero clearance issues. Zero copyright landmines. Zero risk.
t058: You drag the MIDI onto a track.
t059: You load your own sound — your own piano, your own pads, your own synth.
t060: You change the key with one click. You hit play.
t061: And suddenly you're hearing one of the most successful progressions in modern music...
t063: You kept the harmony. You changed the voice.
t064: Put any melody on top, drop your drums under it, and it just works.

t069: 1,000 chord progressions, transcribed 1:1 from real hits and organised by artist.
t070: Pop. Trap. R&B. Country. EDM. Afrobeats. K-pop. Latin.
t071: The full vocabulary of modern hit-making — from The Weeknd to Taylor Swift, from Bad Bunny to Billie Eilish.
t072: Every file labelled with its key and BPM, ready to drop in and transpose to fit your track.
t075: Use them on unlimited beats. Commercial releases included. No DRM. No subscriptions. No fine print.
t076: Compatible with every DAW on earth — FL Studio, Ableton, Logic, Pro Tools, you name it.
t077: You download a .zip. You extract it. The files live on your hard drive forever.
t080: And the math, frankly, speaks for itself.

  DATA.sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0], 'en', { sensitivity: 'base' }));

  const grid = document.getElementById('fbGrid');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('fbCount');
  const artistsEl = document.getElementById('fbArtists');
  const searchEl = document.getElementById('fbSearch');
  const clearEl = document.getElementById('fbClear');
  const searchWrap = searchEl.parentElement;
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById('fbEmpty');
  const resultBar = document.getElementById('fbResultBar');
  const resultText = document.getElementById('fbResultText');

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
  }
  function highlight(text, q) {
    if (!q) return escapeHtml(text);
    const safe = escapeHtml(text);
    const safeQ = escapeHtml(q).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    return safe.replace(new RegExp('(' + safeQ + ')', 'ig'), '<mark>$1</mark>');
  }

  let totalTracks = 0;
  DATA.forEach(([, songs]) => totalTracks += songs.length);
  countEl.textContent = totalTracks;
  artistsEl.textContent = DATA.length;

  function render(query) {
    const q = (query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    let visibleCount = 0;
    let visibleArtists = 0;

    DATA.forEach(([artist, songs]) => {
      const artistMatches = artist.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      const matchedSongs = q
        ? (artistMatches ? songs : songs.filter(s => s[0].toLowerCase().includes(q)))
        : songs;
      if (matchedSongs.length === 0) return;
      visibleCount += matchedSongs.length;
      visibleArtists++;

      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.className = 'fb-artist';
      const songsHtml = matchedSongs.map(([name, bpm]) =>
        `<li class="fb-song">
           <span class="fb-song-name">${highlight(name, q)}</span>
           ${bpm != null ? `<span class="fb-bpm">${bpm} BPM</span>` : ''}
         </li>`
      ).join('');
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="fb-artist-head">
          <h3 class="fb-artist-name">${highlight(artist, q)}</h3>
          <span class="fb-artist-count">${matchedSongs.length}</span>
        </div>
        <ul class="fb-songs">${songsHtml}</ul>
      `;
      grid.appendChild(card);
    });

    emptyEl.hidden = visibleCount > 0;
    if (q) {
      resultBar.hidden = false;
      resultText.textContent = visibleCount + ' / ' + totalTracks + ' progressions \u00b7 ' + visibleArtists + ' artists';
    } else {
      resultBar.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  searchEl.addEventListener('input', e => {
    const v = e.target.value;
    searchWrap.classList.toggle('has-value', v.length > 0);
    render(v);
  });
  clearEl.addEventListener('click', () => {
    searchEl.value = '';
    searchWrap.classList.remove('has-value');
    render('');
    searchEl.focus();
  });

  render('');
